scope: Current hand-written diagnostic ring repair; no native equivalence, game or GPU acceptance

checks.writer_exclusivity: one successful CAS claims unique odd sequence before any of seven atomic payload stores; no overlap
checks.late_reservation: Observed odd or newer/equal committed token rejects; stale relaxed observations cannot CAS over changed slot state
checks.reader_ordering: Initial Acquire sequence orders prior committed payload; if any new payload word is observed, writer Release fence synchronizes reader Acquire fence, so odd/newer sequence precedes final validation; mixed version rejected
checks.counter_semantics: written remains wrapping reservation attempts; busy/stale/CAS lost/exhausted counted as dropped; publication tokens checked and terminal exhaustion prevents normal reuse
checks.test_design: Four deterministic scheduler tests drive actual write_with/records_with production protocol, not duplicate algorithm
checks.performance: One CAS+exhaustion load+drop count where needed; no locks/spin/retry/allocation added per write. Actual throughput not measured

requires_before_merge: root direct rustc unit tests; then previously failing rhapsody lib suite. CPU-only no broad GPU rerun.
